name: command-button
title: Command Button
description: A button that draws its keyboard shortcut as physical keycaps. The shortcut works page-wide: caps sink as keys go down and the button clicks on a match.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut as +-joined parts: mod (Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere), ctrl, alt, shift and one key.

props.name: global
props.description: Listen for the shortcut on the whole page. Plain-key shortcuts are ignored while typing in a field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and its shortcut.
